question: Firefighters donate blood often for a year. What happens to their PFAS?
answer: Firefighters' gear and foams contain PFAS. Each blood or plasma donation physically carries some of these chemicals out of the body. In a 2022 study, frequent donors cut their PFAS levels by up to 30% within a year.
move: Frequent blood or plasma donation lowered firefighters’ PFAS by up to 30% in a year.
